indications: Allergic rhinitis symptom relief.
Urticaria (hives) symptom relief.

age_rules.rule: Many 10 mg tablets are for adults/children ≥6 years (or ≥30 kg); syrup used for younger children depending on product.

major_interactions: Alcohol may increase drowsiness in some people.
Some medicines can raise loratadine levels (e.g., erythromycin/ketoconazole/cimetidine) – usually not clinically significant.
duplicate_therapy_warnings: Don’t combine with another oral antihistamine (duplicate therapy).
